title: Nomad Sportfishing
specs: 52' Hatteras Sportfisher with eco engine and advanced sonar
Personalized sportfishing with just you and your crew, no large groups
Captain Mike Sorr with extensive experience and local knowledge
Bring California and Mexican fishing licenses valid for duration of charter
Bring driver's license or picture ID
Bring passport if fishing within 12 miles of Mexico; photo ID if no passport
Passengers must bring their own sleeping bag or sheets for overnight trips
Private charters for up to 6 guests
includes: Meals included depending on trip: breakfast, lunch, dinner for full days on water
Non-alcoholic beverages and snacks available on board
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests fish for species like Yellowtail, Dorado, Calico Bass, Yellowfin Tuna, and Bluefin Tuna on various trip lengths from hourly to multi-day. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests with private charters, offering meals and snacks included depending on trip length. Passengers bring their own sleeping bags for overnight trips and must have appropriate fishing licenses and ID.
extraNote: Boat staff temperature checked; boat sanitized after every trip

quotes.text: These gents were the real deal. They knew their business, they were helpful, responsive, and accommodating. Captain Mike knew the territory and helped us find the best spots to fish. The whole crew were excellent fishermen who patiently explained the process and helped newcomers like myself catch some serious fish. Even with the little sleep, everyone was upbeat, positive, and enthusiastic about the whole trip. I would definitely recommend this crew to anyone who has never done this before as well as experienced fishermen. Great times.

The Nomad does it right! I’ve been fishing offshore in SoCal for almost 30 years and have chartered just about every boat there is locally. The Nomad is a step above the rest. Not only is the boat a gorgeous fish killer and super comfortable, but Captain Mike and crew were awesome guys and very knowledgeable and helpful! Plus, we caught a ton of fish! The epic food was the icing on the cake for me. They’ll be seeing me again soon!

I had so much fun with my family on this fishing trip. We woke up at 3 AM but it was well worth it!!! We managed to catch 30 yellow tails, they fight hard but hey, they fight= they get eaten. Not to mention: Captain Mike is very fun and informative. How is he immune to sea sickness?! Jason is a very good cook. He made the best breakfast burrito I ever tasted! Overall, thank you for giving us a good fishing time!

Cannot say enough good things about our experience on the Nomad. Took a group of friends out for my bachelor party and had an awesome time. Captain Mike seemed to know all the best spots and we could not stop hauling in yellowtail - plus 3 bluefin - including a 90 pounder. Great service (compliments to chef Humam!), huge boat with brand new engine, and the best fishing! Will be back!

Very spacious boat for 6! Delicious food prepared by the crew and comfortable amenities. Captain and Crew are very helpful and we brought home A LOT of fresh tuna. Highly recommend booking with Captain Mike on the Nomad!

Trevor helped us in the best way possible by gaffing a 100lbs tuna right when the line snapped! #gaffingkingJT, Dave, and Craig were absolutely amazing! Couldn’t ask for a better trip! I’ll see you guys next time!!❤️
